headline: President Bush amended an earlier 2006 order that set up federal efforts to fight identity theft.
what_it_does: This order changes Executive Order 13402, which President Bush signed earlier in 2006 to strengthen federal work against identity theft. That earlier order created a task force of federal agencies to plan how the government would respond to identity theft. The title does not say exactly what was changed, so the specific details of the amendment are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies working on identity theft
who_it_affects.how: The rules or instructions they follow under the earlier identity theft order were changed in some way.
